item.description: The hostility towards cash in Norway is astounding. Just today I tried to pay twice with cash, but was forced to pay with plastic. item.title: Bitcoin's purpose
item.author: mail@juju.casa (Casa de JuJu)
item.description:
Bitcoin as digital gold is a blasphemic statement.

Original post available here

Bitcoin’s purpose is crystal clear. Satoshi Nakamoto’s whitepaper, “Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System,” explicitly outlines Bitcoin as digital cash. The whitepaper discusses creating a decentralized currency for everyday transactions, not a store of value like digital gold. Read the whitepaper and see for yourself.

The spiritual world today is missing masculinity.

Traditionally, men were the spiritual anchors of their communities: shamans, sages, monks, prophets, priests. The rishis in India, the desert fathers in early Christianity, the Stoic philosophers, and indigenous medicine men. These were men who withdrew from the world not because they were weak, but because they were devoted to something higher, and from that space they brought wisdom back to the tribe. Masculinity was deeply tied to asceticism, presence, and spiritual depth.

item.title: At your funeral
item.author: mail@juju.casa (Casa de JuJu)
item.description:
Original post available here

At your funeral, friends and family will argue over who gets your belongings.

People will talk about the food and the venue.

Your life will be summarized in 2-3 paragraphs.

Conversations will shift from your life to their lives.

Your friends will drive away thinking about what’s next on their to-do list.

Some people won’t be able to make it because “something came up."

And most of the people you know today won’t even be there.

You’re gonna die.

People will move on (in weeks not years).

Do what you want.

Lessons from the Sioux in How to Turn a Boy Into a Man

The Indian, in his simple philosophy, was careful to avoid a centralized population, wherein lies civilization’s devil. He would not be forced to accept materialism as the basic principle of his life, but preferred to reduce existence to its simplest terms. His roving out-of-door life was more precarious, no doubt, than life reduced to a system, a mechanical routine; yet in his view it was and is infinitely happier.

item.description: Game meat provides a lot of food for a long time, and should be a top priority if you live in Norway. Grazing animals are a miracle. Greater calorie density also means we don’t have to eat all the time, as we do if we eat plant-based. The choice is ridiculously simple if you live in Norway: All animal and local food is better than importing avocados and bananas from faraway lands.

item.title: About
item.author: mail@juju.casa (Casa de JuJu)
item.description:
Welcome to Casa de JuJu 👋🏼

Aloha! I’m an INFJ from Colombia 🇨🇴, currently rooted in Norway 🇳🇴.

I like to explore the balance between modern life and our ancient connection to the earth. I look for complementary patterns in nature and in human relationships. Yin and yang, masculine and feminine, structure and flow.

I am passionate about rewilding strategies, agorism, sociology, genital sun exposure, evolutionary astrology and decentralized privacy tools that support personal freedom.
